0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 14th in the West, fifth in the Southwest and 3.5 games back) host the Denver Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the West) in the Pelicans' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with New Orleans on a three-game losing streak. Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and the Pelicans lost all three meetings in 2025-26. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision, while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Cameron Johnson day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision.
